variants.headline: Hungry people, hard questions
variants.body: People in {colony} are hungry. There is not enough food. Whatever the argument, nobody can eat a speech. Keep asking the questions.

variants.headline: A meal matters more than a loud headline
variants.body: There is not enough food in {colony}, and people are hungry. A polished explanation is no substitute for something to eat. Keep asking the questions.

variants.headline: Food first, guessing later
variants.body: Food is short in {colony}. People are hungry. The grandest vision of a new life still needs room for a meal. Keep asking the questions.
